notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional untapped creature.
description:
Activate Opposition by tapping an untapped creature you control, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tapped in step 1, adding {1}.
Resolve the Hylda of the Icy Crown trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.
